'''Liana Merian''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] rule as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Merian served as one of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]]' [[Senatorial aide|aides]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], she witnessed the [[Politics/Legends|political]] crisis engineered by the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. A [[Time/Legends|decade]] [[22 BBY/Legends|later]], shortly before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Merian joined the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] branch of the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]]&mdash;or RRM. She worked alongside her compatriot [[Celly Organa/Legends|Celly Organa]], [[Chairman/Legends|Chair]] of the RRM, and the former Chancellor Valorum, in preparing the [[Chianar]] site, a 100-[[Hectare/Legends|hectare]] plot, for settlement.

==Biography==
[[File:LianaMerian-CoruscantLimited.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Senatorial aide Liana Merian]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Liana Merian came from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="db" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] renowned throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for its natural beauty,<ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> in the decades leading up to the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="db" /> At seventeen, Merian reached the [[age of responsibility]], becoming a fully responsible adult in the eyes of the local legislation.<ref name="Age of responsibility">It was established in ''[[Rebel Dawn]]'' that the "age of responsibility" on both Alderaan and Corellia was set at seventeen.</ref> She chose to pursue a [[Politics/Legends|political]] career, and she eventually attained the position of [[senatorial aide]]. During the rule of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], Merian joined the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as part of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Alderaanian delegation/Legends|delegation]] led by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], she shared her duties with [[Agrippa Aldrete/Legends|Agrippa Aldrete]],<ref name="db" /> an older gentleman who had been the current senator's immediate predecessor.<ref name="dbALD">{{DB|character|aldrete|Aldrete, Agrippa}}</ref> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Liana Merian was serving under Antilles<ref name="db" /> when the peaceful planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|besieged]] by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], an event that led to the removal of Chancellor Valorum and the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|election]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of Naboo.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="NEC" /> Merian had returned to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. There, she helped the local branch of the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]]&mdash;or RMM for short&mdash;settle a new [[City/Legends|village]] at [[Chianar]], a 100-[[Hectare/Legends|hectare]] plot on the [[Color/Legends|green]] plains of Alderaan. During her involvement with the project at Chianar, Liana Merian worked alongside prestigious personalities such as [[Celly Organa/Legends|Celly Organa]], [[Chairman/Legends|Chairwoman]] of the RRM, and the former Chancellor Valorum. She attended the sod-turning ceremony of the new settlement along with Finis Valorum, and her presence was immortalized in a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report.<ref name="HN9N" />

==Personality and traits==
Liana Merian was a slender woman with light skin and long, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] she would coil in twin buns.<ref name="db" /> Most Alderaanians were educated and cultured pacifists who displayed redoubtable inner strength. They were far from passive, and they refused to fight only because they had chosen the nobler path of diplomacy.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> The senatorial aide Merian lived up to this reputation. She was proud of her homeworld, and was known to use the prosperous example of Alderaan to actively promote peace throughout the Republican Space. Encouraging trade was also part of her political agenda.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Liana Merian}}</ref> As a member of the RRM, she also cared for the homeless citizens of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], those who were displaced by the closure of planets that joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems.<ref name="HN9N" />

==Equipment==
When serving in the Senate, she put on bright-red lipstick and donned a simple, yet elegant, full length [[Robe/Legends|robe]] with puffed sleeves and a turtleneck.<ref name="db" /> The white color of her dress showed her ties with the Alderaanian ambassadorial milieu.<ref name="CoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> When she needed to roll up her sleeves to help with the RMM's ground-breaking ceremony, Merian had swapped her ambassadorial robe for more practical work [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]]. In a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] News report, Merian was seen wearing a knee-length, cream-colored tunic with wrist bindings, a pair of trousers and sturdy work [[Boot/Legends|boots]] along with a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]].<ref name="HN9N" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AlderaanianDelegation.png|thumb|250px|The cut Alderaanian delegation in ''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]
Liana Merian was among the many secondary characters that were cut from the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''Star Wars'' [[prequel trilogy]]. Merian was portrayed by an uncredited actress and had a single, non-speaking appearance in a Galactic Senate scene, along with Agrippa Aldrete, a [[Unidentified draped senator|draped Human]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]&mdash;played by [[Adrian Dunbar]]. In this scene, Organa seconded [[King/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] that removed Chancellor Valorum from office.<ref name="TPM cut">{{Film|I}}, deleted scene featured on the Blu-ray edition.</ref> The footage was left on the cutting-room floor, but Dunbar's character was ultimately identified as Bail Antilles,<ref name="dbOrg">{{DB|character|bailorgana|Organa, Bail}}</ref> and a picture of Liana Merian was released in [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], bringing the character back into [[canon]].<ref name="TPMV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
